C-SKELETON-GENERATORS.Summary: Deliver RM-GOVERNED-PATH P1 step 5 only: add spec new, plan new, and scaffold commands that write valid-by-construction skeletons from the live grammar inventories and from the single production MODULE_CONTRACT renderer, so an agent can emit a shape-valid spec, plan, or module markup block without reading src/artifact/grammar.ts. The existing spec and plan skill templates are regenerated from that same renderer's teaching emission (required core plus the optional teaching the skills name), not from the CLI skeleton emission. P1.6 as-state, P1.7 export view, and P1.8 no-adapter preflight are out.
C-SKELETON-GENERATORS.Problem:
**Shared shape.** P1.5 exists so an agent can author a valid artifact without reading TypeScript or copying the polyglot example. The step asks for three generators: spec new and plan new write skeletons with every mandatory section and the canonical empty marker where emptiness is legal; scaffold with the module flag emits the MODULE_CONTRACT / MODULE_MAP block for the module's declared Path with correct ROLE / MAP_MODE / LINKS. The headline acceptance test is that generated output passes lint when committed unmodified. Authoring HEAD 3e5c3d8, packaged 6.2.0, lint 0/0 across 131 XML artifacts, active changes empty before this bundle, suite 1307 pass / 3 skip / 0 fail. Those numbers are a snapshot (F33).
---
**No command surface exists.** src/grace.ts registers context, cursor, doctor, file, gate, graph, lint, module, review, status, and verification. There is no spec, plan, or scaffold command. This bundle is greenfield CLI surface plus a renderer, not a repair of an existing verb.
---
**The headline test is not one property (F45, Trap A).** validateMeaningfulSection accepts any non-empty descendant text, so a placeholder such as $SUMMARY satisfies change.empty-section by construction. A criterion that says only "generated output passes lint unmodified" has a half that cannot be reddened without manufacturing a failure. The real properties are listed on AC-LINT-PROPERTIES; the construction half is exempted on AC-HEAD-RED at authoring time.
---
**Trap C, measured, not inferred.** An active plan beside a non-approved spec is change.plan-requires-approved-spec (error): "An active plan may exist only beside an approved spec." Generating both from the shipped templates into .ngrace/changes/active/C-PROBE/ (wrapper id substituted only) produced two errors, not one:
change.plan-requires-approved-spec on the bundle directory.
change.graph-anchors-miss-write-scope on plan.xml, because the plan template's ObservedWriteScope names File src/path/to/file.ts, which is not a governed file whose MODULE_CONTRACT LINKS include a GraphAnchors module.
Follow-up measurements on the same HEAD, then deleted: draft spec only from the spec template is 0/0; approved spec plus the unmodified plan template is still the write-scope error; approved spec plus the same plan with ObservedWriteScope replaced by None is 0/0. So the pair can be lint-green, but only when the spec is approved and ObservedWriteScope is the canonical empty marker, not a placeholder src path. The probe directory was deleted; the working tree was clean afterwards.
Therefore "generate spec and plan, commit unmodified, lint green" cannot hold for a draft pair, and cannot hold for output that copies the current plan template's File placeholder. The resolution is decided below, not left to the plan.
---
**The templates are a second grammar (Trap B, F46, F10) and they are also teaching artifacts (F63).** Five hand-written XML kinds ship as copy-sources, each mirrored. They return zero hits in the lint universe. Leaving the spec and plan templates as a second hand-maintained shape is F10: the plan template's File placeholder is already a shape lint rejects. Collapsing them to the CLI skeleton (required sections only) is also F10: ngrace-spec SKILL.md tells the author to write spec.xml from the spec template and to add DesignReferences when Figma or research exist; ngrace-plan SKILL.md produces plan.xml from the plan template; both templates carry commented, filled examples of Clarifications in the self-closing anchor-child form (C-GRAMMAR-SEAM's product) and the plan template carries commented OutOfPlanScope. A check that compares template to skeleton agrees by definition after it deletes that teaching, and validate:marketplace is green when both trees lose the same content. F63: a generator skeleton and a teaching template are different products. This bundle therefore keeps one renderer with two emissions. CLI spec new / plan new write the skeleton emission. The four spec/plan template files are the teaching emission. The other three template kinds stay on P1.11. SKILL.md is not edited.
---
**The markup renderer already exists in test-support (Trap D, F60).** src/test-support/fixtures.ts defines renderModuleContract, renderModuleMap, and commentPrefixForExtension. Only the last is exported; the first two are reached from tests only through GraceProjectBuilder. commentPrefixForExtension handles a subset of CODE_EXTENSIONS and defaults the rest to the slash-slash prefix, including .pyi, which is a Python stub and whose comment prefix is hash. A second renderer in production would be the F60 class: two implementations that will disagree. The production parser already lives in src/project-utils.ts beside private inferRole and defaultMapMode. Those are the functions scaffold must call, not reimplement.
---
**inferRole is TEST or RUNTIME only.** BARREL, CONFIG, TYPES, and SCRIPT are never inferred. Scaffold must not invent a second inference table. ROLE is inferRole of the Path; MAP_MODE is defaultMapMode of that ROLE. House-style ROLE values the author wants beyond TEST / RUNTIME are a later edit of the emitted block.
---
**Exact MODULE_MAP requires an adapter and a body.** LanguageAdapter.analyze already exists; P1.7 is a read-only CLI view of the same function and is not a dependency. Of 21 governed extensions, five adapters back a derived ADAPTER_BACKED_EXTENSIONS set. Without an adapter, or with an empty symbol set for the required map mode, an "exact" MODULE_MAP cannot be produced. Emitting a guessed entry would be a second truth. Scaffold refuses those cases.
---
**F61.** xml.comment-not-well-formed is error severity. This spec names argv tokens and exported functions in any comment body and does not write dashed CLI flags inside XML comments. Element text may name a dashed form; this file prefers argv tokens everywhere so a later comment cannot regress it.

Goals.Goal: **Three generators, one bundle.** spec new, plan new, and scaffold ship together. Scaffold does not depend on P1.7 (analyze already exists). Nothing is split for size (D11).

**Live grammar skeletons.** spec and plan skeletons are rendered from the GRAMMAR_INVENTORIES bindings the validators already close over, not from a copied section list and not by reading grammar.ts as text. Liveness is proved by probe mutation of an inventory, observing the rendered bytes change, and restoring.

**One markup renderer.** The MODULE_CONTRACT / MODULE_MAP renderer and the comment-prefix function live in production (src/project-utils.ts). Test fixtures import those same bindings. comment prefix covers every CODE_EXTENSIONS member with the prefix the production parser already accepts; .py and .pyi share hash.

**Spec and plan templates stop being a second grammar without deleting their teaching (F63).** The four spec/plan template files (canonical and packaged) are the teaching emission of the same renderer the CLI calls for the skeleton. A check that validate:ci runs fails when they differ from that teaching emission or are missing. The teaching emission still shows DesignReferences, Clarifications (working form), and OutOfPlanScope. The other three template kinds are untouched. SKILL.md is not edited.

**Honest lint claim.** The properties that are real, and the half that is true by construction, are named on AC-LINT-PROPERTIES and AC-HEAD-RED. The generator does not write a state lint would reject.

**README names the new commands and cannot drift from the live root list.** The CLI Overview table lists every registered command root. A check bound to liveCommandRoots fails when a root is absent from that table. examples/ stays a named NonGoal owned by P1.11.

Constraints.Constraint: Ceremony tier **T2** (new CLI verbs + grammar-driven renderer with skeleton and teaching emissions + moving the markup renderer out of test-support + regenerating four template files from the teaching emission + CI stale-check + README command table bound to the live root list + the three CI pins the deliverable falsifies). P1.6 as-state, P1.7 export view, P1.8 no-adapter preflight, P1.10 skill inversion, and P1.11 polyglot plus the remaining templates are out of implementation.

**Decided here — one bundle, three verbs.** Default is one bundle. The candidate dependency (scaffold needs P1.7) does not hold: LanguageAdapter.analyze already exists and both P1.5 scaffold and P1.7 are callers. No other dependency or conflict was found. Do not split.

**Decided here — command shape and homes.** grace.ts registers three new top-level commands: spec, plan, and scaffold. spec and plan each have a new subcommand. One new published command module src/grace-generate.ts exports the three command defs and LINKS M-CLI; it is not a new graph module. package.json files lists that new path (src/artifact/ already covers the renderer). Commands are wrapped with defineGraceCommand. This bundle adds no boolean args, so the live boolean-site cardinality does not move; the live-root walk in src/query/command.test.ts must still include the new roots so a later boolean cannot hide. Do not keep a walk name that states a count (F10). Errors are GraceCommandError using the existing closed code union only (invalid-arguments, invalid-project, not-found, ambiguous-target). No JSON format flag on these commands.

**Decided here — change id.** The positional slug must already match ANCHOR_PATTERNS.change (C-, then uppercase kebab). Do not prepend the C- prefix (silent repair is filtering). An invalid token is invalid-arguments and names the accepted pattern. Refuse if .ngrace/changes/active/C-ID or .ngrace/changes/archive/C-ID already exists as a directory; name the existing location. argv token path (alias p) is the project root, default the current working directory, matching the other commands.

**Decided here — spec new output.** Writes .ngrace/changes/active/C-ID/spec.xml. Creates the directory. Refuses if the file exists (invalid-arguments, names the path). Does not overwrite. First line of stdout is the project-relative written path (F44). Root is NgraceChangeSpec; graceVersion is the live NGRACE_ARTIFACT_VERSION; status is draft; the direct wrapper tag is the change id. Every SPEC_REQUIRED_SECTIONS member is present, in that inventory's order, with placeholder text that is non-empty. AffectedAreas contains one canonical module anchor M-AFFECTED-MODULE. AcceptanceCriteria contains one AC-SKELETON child with placeholder text. This is the skeleton emission. Optional sections (Problem, Assumptions, DesignReferences, Clarifications) are not live children, and teaching comments are not written: they belong to the teaching emission only (F63). The renderer reads the live inventory; it does not copy the seven names.

**Decided here — plan new output and Trap C resolution.** Writes .ngrace/changes/active/C-ID/plan.xml. Creates nothing if the spec is missing or not approved: refuse with invalid-arguments, name the spec path, and state that an active plan may exist only beside an approved spec (the same rule change.plan-requires-approved-spec enforces). Do not write the file and leave lint to catch it. Refuse if plan.xml already exists. First line of stdout is the project-relative written path. Root is NgraceChangePlan; graceVersion is the live NGRACE_ARTIFACT_VERSION; status is draft; wrapper tag is the change id. Every PLAN_REQUIRED_SECTIONS member is present, in inventory order. BaselineAssertions and TargetAssertions each contain at least one child whose tag is a member of ASSERTION_SECTION_TAGS (MustExist naming the first spec AffectedAreas module anchor, or M-AFFECTED-MODULE when seeding from the renderer-only synthetic spec). ObservedWriteScope is a single None child — never a placeholder File under src/. DurableScope GraphAnchors is seeded from the approved spec's AffectedAreas module and flow anchors so change.scope-does-not-cover-spec does not fire. ImplementationPlan contains T-001 with every TASK_REQUIRED_SECTIONS member: non-empty Title, empty DependsOn, one non-empty Criterion, one non-empty Command. Satisfies lists every AC-* the spec authored; if the spec has no AC-* (author edited them out before plan new), Satisfies is omitted. This is the skeleton emission. OutOfPlanScope and Clarifications are not live children and teaching comments are not written (F63). The renderer reads the live inventories; it does not copy the six or four names.

**Decided here — scaffold output.** argv token module is required and must match ANCHOR_PATTERNS.module. Unknown module is not-found and names the id. A module with no Path (this repository's M-SKILLS) is invalid-arguments and names that absence. The Path file must exist (not-found if missing); scaffold does not create source files. Default and only output is stdout: the exact MODULE_CONTRACT block followed by the MODULE_MAP block, using the production renderer. Scaffold does not write the Path file (no boolean write flag). ROLE is inferRole of the Path (TEST or RUNTIME). MAP_MODE is defaultMapMode of that ROLE. LINKS is the module id. DEPENDS is the accepted token none. PURPOSE and SCOPE are non-empty placeholders. Comment prefix comes from the production commentPrefixForExtension of the Path extension. MODULE_MAP entries are adapter.analyze of the existing file body, exports or localSymbols according to MAP_MODE. Refuse invalid-arguments when the Path extension is not in ADAPTER_BACKED_EXTENSIONS, or when the required symbol set is empty: an exact map cannot be produced. Do not emit a guessed entry. Do not reimplement inferRole, defaultMapMode, or analyze.

**Decided here — source of truth and drift.** Spec/plan renderer: new src/artifact/skeletons.ts, LINKS M-GRAMMAR, reads GRAMMAR_INVENTORIES and NGRACE_ARTIFACT_VERSION live. Markup renderer: move renderModuleContract, renderModuleMap, and commentPrefixForExtension to src/project-utils.ts and export them; fixtures.ts deletes its copies and imports the production bindings (same references, not wrappers that rebuild). Probe mutation of SPEC_REQUIRED_SECTIONS, PLAN_REQUIRED_SECTIONS, and TASK_REQUIRED_SECTIONS changes the required core of both the skeleton emission and the teaching emission; restore in finally. The suite asserts commentPrefixForExtension(".pyi") is hash, and that fixtures.commentPrefixForExtension is the project-utils export if fixtures re-exports it at all. validate:ci invokes a writer check (scripts/generate-skeleton-templates.ts check mode, composed like validate:schema-reference) that exits non-zero when either spec/plan template in either skill tree is missing or differs from the teaching emission. Green on a clean post-change tree is the baseline, not the evidence.

**Decided here — templates (F63).** One renderer, two emissions. Regenerated, not left, not deleted, not reduced to the skeleton. The four files are:
skills/ngrace/ngrace-spec/references/change-spec-template.xml
skills/ngrace/ngrace-plan/references/change-plan-template.xml
and the two packaged mirrors under plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/.
Spec template bytes equal the teaching emission of renderChangeSpec for C-CHANGE-ID. Plan template bytes equal the teaching emission of renderChangePlan for C-CHANGE-ID seeded from that synthetic spec. The required core of both emissions is the same function (live inventories, ObservedWriteScope None, seeded DurableScope and Satisfies). The teaching appendix is a closed, named list in the renderer, not claimed to be a grammar inventory (F10):
spec teaching, live: Problem, Assumptions, DesignReferences whose children are the live DESIGN_REFERENCE_CHILD_TAGS members (Figma with an http(s) example url, UserResearch with a contained project-relative example path).
spec teaching, commented: Clarifications showing the working form (exactly one self-closing IC-* / INV-* / AC-* child; the live CLARIFICATION_WORKING_FORM).
plan teaching, commented: OutOfPlanScope with a non-empty Reason child, and Clarifications in the same working form targeting AC-SKELETON.
Instructional comments that survive from the current templates must remain F61-clean (measured: nine comment bodies, zero contain two adjacent hyphens). New comment text the renderer emits is subject to the same rule. No generated banner inside the XML. SKILL.md is not edited (F51 unpaid): both named write-from-template lines still resolve to a file that shows the shape they name. design-context, design-system, and migration-report templates are not this renderer and are not updated. validate:marketplace must stay green because both trees change together. The File placeholder is not part of either emission.

**Decided here — F56 signature keys.** decideFixBudgetEscalation (src/grace-cursor.ts) compares FailureSignature values by exact kind plus key equality (failureSignaturesEqual). Trigger R fires when the current signature appears FIX_SIGNATURE_REPEAT_BUDGET (2) times in the window. Trigger D fires when the distinct kind-plus-key set reaches FIX_DISTINCT_SIGNATURE_BUDGET (4). The kind and key are not derived from the test output: cursor attempt takes argv tokens signatureKind and signatureKey, and recordAttempt stores them as authored. Citty reporting an unknown command for spec, plan, and scaffold is therefore the same failure class and is indistinguishable unless the recorded key names the command. A task that records two of those reds with the same kind and the same key trips trigger R and pauses itself. What makes the three reds distinguishable: the recorded key must include the command argv token (spec, plan, or scaffold). A task may plan at most one unknown-command red, or several only with those distinct keys, and never more than three distinct kind-plus-key pairs in one window.

**Decided here — what "passes lint unmodified" actually means.** Three checkable facts, all required. (1) A draft spec written by spec new, committed as the only file in its active bundle, produces 0 errors and 0 warnings. (2) A draft plan written by plan new beside the approved spec it refused to skip, committed unmodified, produces 0 errors and 0 warnings. (3) plan new never writes beside a missing or non-approved spec, so the illegal pair is not a generator output. Scaffold's emitted block, placed at the top of a fixture file whose extension is adapter-backed and whose body has a non-empty symbol set for the inferred map mode, produces 0 markup errors (map mismatch, missing contract field, invalid role, role/map mismatch). The placeholder-text half of change.empty-section is true by construction and is not sold as evidence of new work (F45).

**Do not edit** docs/plans/**, .ngrace/changes/archive/**, CHANGELOG.md, or any version surface. Packaged version at authoring: **6.2.0**. No product version bump — 6.3.0 is a phase target, not this bundle's act. Newly visible commands are named in the conventional commit body (D5.5), not in CHANGELOG.md.

Evidence doctrine: red-first is mechanical for new behaviour. Failing tests are written before the fail attempt is recorded, in a separate tool round trip. Never a retrospective red via stash. Never weaken a BaselineAssertion to move a lint count. F45 carve-outs are named on AC-HEAD-RED. F56: the plan splits criteria so no task plans more than three distinct kind-plus-key pairs, and no task records the same kind-plus-key twice; unknown-command reds are keyed by the command argv token as decided above. F42: plan assertions must not use as a MustContain or MustNotContain needle any required section name, placeholder token, M-AFFECTED-MODULE, AC-SKELETON, DesignReferences child name, Clarification working-form phrase, OutOfPlanScope, or other template phrase either emission will emit; bind to implementation symbols (renderer export, teaching-emission flag, command module export, writer check-mode exit, production commentPrefixForExtension) instead. F43: this spec binds semantics; tests assert literal bytes. F39.1 / F61: this bundle's artifacts must not hold two adjacent hyphen characters inside any XML comment body.

NonGoals.NonGoal: P1.6 lint as-state evaluation. Generators cover write-time; as-state covers evolution-time of hand-edited artifacts. Non-overlapping.
P1.7 adapter export view. Scaffold calls analyze directly. A read-only exports command is a later step, not a dependency.

P1.8 no-adapter preflight warning. File-level analysis.no-adapter already exists on project-utils.ts. Scaffold refuses when there is no adapter rather than emitting a block that warning would then attach to. Widening or relocating that warning is P1.8.

P1.10 skill inversion (SKILL.md stops restating formats). This bundle does not edit SKILL.md (F51 unpaid; F63 does not require it). Skills will still name the templates; the templates will now be the teaching emission, which still shows the shapes those lines name. Teaching the CLI as the primary authoring path is P1.10.

P1.11 polyglot rebalance and the fill-and-lint check for design-context, design-system, and migration-report templates. F46's remaining home. This bundle's check is byte-identity of the four spec/plan templates to the teaching emission, which is a different property.

examples/ including examples/polyglot. Owned by P1.11. That tree holds its own change bundles; new CLI verbs do not alter them. README.md is in scope as the user-visible command surface; examples/ is the named NonGoal for the docs-and-examples pair.
**Rejected — copy the current templates into the generator.** The plan template's File placeholder fails lint when committed (measured). Copying it would fail AC-LINT-PROPERTIES by construction.
**Rejected — a second MODULE_CONTRACT renderer, or leaving the test-support copies in place.** F60. The production functions are the only implementation.
**Rejected — infer BARREL, CONFIG, TYPES, or SCRIPT.** inferRole does not. A second table would drift from the parser. Authors edit ROLE after emit if they need those values.

**Rejected — scaffold writes the Path file, or a boolean write / force / json / stdout flag on any of the three commands.** File write of markup into source is a different product (insertion vs emit). Boolean flags would move the live-site pin in command.test.ts (F18 class coverage). Spec and plan write files; scaffold prints. Adding those flags is a re-spec.
**Rejected — auto-approve the generated spec so plan new can always run.** draft to approved stays authored (RM-GOVERNED-PATH D1). The generator does not write status.
**Rejected — generate design-context, design-system, or migration-report.** Not this step's artifacts.

**Rejected — emit optional sections as live children of the CLI skeleton emission.** They are not required sections. The teaching emission does emit the closed appendix named under templates (F63); that is not this rejection.
docs/plans/** board edits, CHANGELOG.md, product version bump, grammar validator behaviour changes, new GraceCommandError codes, new graph modules. Conflict: this bundle does not close 6.3.0.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SPEC-NEW: spec new of a canonical change id against a temp project with no such bundle writes .ngrace/changes/active/C-ID/spec.xml and exits 0. First line of stdout is that project-relative path. The file's root, graceVersion, status, and wrapper match the decided shape. Every live SPEC_REQUIRED_SECTIONS member appears as a direct wrapper child, in inventory order, with non-empty text or a canonical anchor child. AffectedAreas contains M-AFFECTED-MODULE. AcceptanceCriteria contains AC-SKELETON. Optional sections named in Constraints are absent as live children, and teaching comments are absent: spec new writes the skeleton emission, not the teaching emission. A second invocation on the same id exits non-zero with invalid-arguments and does not change the file. A slug that does not match ANCHOR_PATTERNS.change exits non-zero with invalid-arguments and writes nothing, including when the slug would be valid after prepending C-. An id that already exists under archive/ is refused the same way. **HEAD today:** no spec command; citty reports an unknown command. **Failure conditions:** stdout-only with no file; overwrite; silent C- prefix; wrapper not the id; required section missing or out of inventory order; copied section list that ignores a live inventory edit; Problem, DesignReferences, or a teaching comment emitted by spec new; first stdout line is not the path.
